note: 'This cup is the new covenant in My blood; do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of Me' (1Cor 11:25). The plainest statement of it; Matthew 26:28 gives the same identification as 'this is my blood of the new covenant'.
The same word. The drink keeps its own verses -- Cana, the warnings, Timothy's stomach -- and this edge says only that the figure is built on it.

'the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine' (John 2:9); the verse does not name him as the maker and 2:11 does -- 'Jesus performed this, the first of His signs, at Cana in Galilee'.
